items.title: Trailer
items.caption: Trade. Fight. Explore. Build. Fifty seconds over the Blue Danube: the exchange in a famine, a pirate pack and the Falcon, hyperspace, a survey, the Titanoboa building a station, and the 1984 look.

items.title: Trailer: social cut
items.caption: Twenty-three seconds, made for social posts: a fight, the market, a survey, the yard and the 1984 switch.

items.title: Trailer: vertical
items.caption: Twenty-three seconds upright, for stories, reels and phones.

items.title: The docking waltz
items.caption: The docking computer lines up on the slot and flies you in, to the Blue Danube. Thirty-four seconds.

items.title: The Marshals arrive
items.caption: Break the law badly enough and a witchspace rift tears open: the Co-operative Marshals’ Bastion slides through. Thirty-five seconds.

items.title: The Falcon
items.caption: Something out there running dark: a cold white unknown, then the hull read. The Falcon. Fifteen seconds.

items.title: Dogfight
items.caption: A pirate pack over a ringed world, military lasers on gimbals swinging onto each one. Eighteen seconds.

items.title: Building a station
items.caption: Wexley-Yorozu’s Titanoboa builds a station, stage by stage, where everyone can see. Twenty-one seconds.

items.title: The first trailer (October 2026)
items.caption: 53 seconds: trading, a dogfight, scooping, the Marshals, and the docking computer's waltz. The music is The Blue Danube, performed by the United States Marine Band (public domain).

items.title: Mamba destroyed
items.caption: Military lasers break up a pirate Mamba over a ringed world: the bounty comes in, and one of its pack taunts you on the radio.

items.title: Debris across a ringed world
items.caption: The wreck of a pirate Sidewinder tumbling across the planet, the military lasers still converging. No HUD.

items.title: Breaking up
items.caption: A pirate comes apart in front of the planet’s rings, sparks scattering. No HUD.

items.title: A pack closing
items.caption: A pirate Sidewinder crosses the planet with the rest of its pack behind it. Pirates hunt in packs in lawless systems.

items.title: A Mamba breaks up close
items.caption: A pirate Mamba breaks up at point-blank range. No HUD.

items.title: The Falcon
items.caption: A Legend: a lone pirate running dark, red once you’re close enough to read her hull. Nobody sees her twice.

items.title: The Falcon, close
items.caption: The Falcon at a hundred metres, wings swept, crossing a ringed world.

items.title: Dogfight
items.caption: Military lasers on a Sidewinder at point-blank range, a Mamba beyond it and the station in the distance. The red is your own shields taking hits.

items.title: Crossfire
items.caption: Pirate beams cross yours as a Mamba breaks away. Gimballed lasers track whatever is under the ring.

items.title: The police join in
items.caption: Police Vipers go after a pirate band, through the wreckage of the last one.

items.title: Breaking up
items.caption: Every face of a destroyed hull becomes a tumbling, white-hot fragment. Whatever was in the hold floats free for anyone with fuel scoops.

items.title: The exchange in a famine
items.caption: Trading from the dock at Leesti during a famine: the food price candles up, with the news that moved it marked on the chart.

items.title: Company contracts
items.caption: The contracts board: work for the four trading companies, each with its own standing and its own file on you.

items.title: The news, as it reaches Lave
items.caption: News travels at the speed of ships: famines, booms and a station rising, each with how old it was when it arrived.

items.title: The exchange
items.caption: Station markets as a trading exchange: pairs, a candlestick chart, the order book and limit orders. NPC traders, supply chains and world events move the prices.

items.title: The hangar
items.caption: The equipment shop, with what you fit drawn on the ship in its berth.

items.title: Company work
items.caption: The Contracts board at Lave: Vorg Industries, the Carriers' Mutual and Wexley-Yorozu each have a special assignment waiting. They supply the cargo; you fly it there within so many jumps.

items.title: The trade computer
items.caption: The ship's computer ranks the best trade runs from where you're docked, so you can see what to carry and where.

items.title: Surveying Diso
items.caption: Holding low over Diso while the survey runs. The data sells, and the first commander to bring it home goes on the chart.

items.title: Low over Diso
items.caption: The limb of Diso, the sun beyond and the station’s traffic in the distance. No HUD.

items.title: An old beacon
items.caption: A survey beacon from before the station was built, still transmitting a star chart that is no longer true.

items.title: A beacon and its world
items.caption: The old beacon against the planet it was charting. No HUD.

items.title: The galactic chart
items.caption: Eight galaxies of 2,048 star systems, generated just where they were in 1984.

items.title: Local chart
items.caption: Lave and its neighbours inside the fuel circle, with Diso selected: average agricultural, democracy, home of the Black Furry Felines.

items.title: The Titanoboa
items.caption: Wexley-Yorozu’s Titanoboa at work: a mobile shipyard that builds stations by moons, stage by stage, over days.

items.title: A station rising
items.caption: The frame of a new station taking shape beside the Titanoboa, where every commander can see it.

items.title: The yard by its moon
items.caption: The Titanoboa and its new station by the moon they’re building at.

items.title: A Coriolis station
items.caption: The station turning, its slot facing out. No HUD.

items.title: The station from below
items.caption: A Coriolis station from beneath. No HUD.

items.title: The Marshals arrive (clip)
items.caption: Nine seconds, silent, made for social posts: a Co-operative Marshals carrier comes through a witchspace rift as it closes.

items.title: A witchspace rift
items.caption: Commit a serious crime and the Co-operative Marshals come for you. You get half a minute's warning as a rift opens and space bends around it.

items.title: The Bastion comes through
items.caption: An 805-metre Marshals carrier slides out of the rift as it closes around its stern.

items.title: Lancers launch
items.caption: The Bastion launches its Lancer interceptors in pairs from the bow bay. Read the signs and you'll be gone before they reach you.

items.title: Docked, fully kitted
items.caption: Docked on an iPhone: a Cobra with military lasers on all four mounts.

items.title: The market on a phone
items.caption: Trading from the dock on an iPhone during the Leesti famine.

items.title: The news on a phone
items.caption: The news as it reaches the station, each system a link to the chart.

items.title: A fight on a phone
items.caption: Flying and fighting on an iPhone held sideways: drag to aim, the fire button under your thumb.

items.title: Closing on a pack, on a phone
items.caption: A pirate pack closing, on an iPhone held sideways.

items.title: On an iPhone
items.caption: The title screen on an iPhone. Add Witchspace to your Home Screen and it plays full screen, like an app.

items.title: Contracts on a phone
items.caption: Messages from the companies and the work on offer, docked at Lave, upright on a phone.

items.title: The chart on a phone
items.caption: The local chart on a phone: drag to look around, tap a system to read about it, tap again to set your course.

items.title: Flying on a phone
items.caption: In flight on a phone held sideways: drag to aim, tilt to steer if you like, and the missile button turns red once it has locked on a pirate.

items.title: The same moment: neo-vector
items.caption: A pirate pack over a ringed world in neo-vector, glowing lines and bloom. Its pair is the same moment in 1984 mode.

items.title: The same moment: 1984
items.caption: The same moment in 1984 mode: white lines on black, as the original drew them. Press M at any time.

items.title: Neo-vector
items.caption: A Coriolis station and its planet in the glowing neo-vector look.

items.title: 1984 mode
items.caption: The same scene, one keypress later: white lines on black, scaled by whole pixels so it stays crisp.

items.title: Combat in 1984 mode
items.caption: A Sidewinder under fire, drawn the way a BBC Micro would have.
